description: Hacienda Jacana is a retreat and lodge based in Talparo, Trinidad. It was established in 2010 on an old citrus estate and offers a unique experience for guests. The site is a birdwatcher's paradise, boasting over 175 species. (www.haciendajacana.com). Listed opening hours: Monday - Sunday from 8 am - 4 pm. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
